jobs.title: Senior Director, Data, AI, & Automation Services
jobs.description:
As a member of the Business Systems leadership team reporting to the Vice President, Business Systems, the Director, Data, AI & Automation Services leads Bird's enterprise data, analytics, AI, automation, and information governance services. The role is accountable for translating business strategy into a practical Data, AI & Automation roadmap that improves decision-making, project and operational performance, productivity, and responsible innovation across Bird.

The Director leads the modernization of Bird's data platform and analytics ecosystem, establishes scalable AI and automation capabilities, and advances enterprise data governance, data quality, stewardship, and data fluency. Working with executive sponsors, business leaders, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Enterprise Architecture, and delivery teams, this role ensures data and AI capabilities are trusted, secure, adopted, and measurable in business value.

What You Will Be Working On

Develop and execute Bird's enterprise Data, AI, Analytics, and Automation strategy, aligned with corporate objectives and the priorities of the Business Systems leadership team, translating business strategy into measurable outcomes across decision-making, operational excellence, and innovation.
Establish and maintain a multi-year roadmap and prioritized portfolio for data modernization, AI adoption, analytics, automation services, and information governance — sequencing initiatives by business value, risk, feasibility, and adoption readiness, and reporting quantified value realization to executive leadership.
Lead the modernization and operation of Bird's enterprise data platform, including lakehouse, Azure Databricks, semantic models, enterprise data models, metadata, data pipelines, and analytics architecture, in partnership with Business Subject Matter Experts, Data Architects, and Business Analysts.
Establish and maintain enterprise standards for analytics, reporting, data engineering, AI solution development, and delivery governance — covering architecture reviews, solution design reviews, testing, release management, training, documentation, and operational support.
Lead enterprise data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata, stewardship, and information lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements — including ownership of the Semarchy MDM tool and enterprise data standards.
Establish and operationalize responsible AI governance and lifecycle controls for Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, machine learning, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation — covering AI inventory, human oversight, third-party AI/data risk, monitoring, incident response, and decommissioning, aligned with recognized frameworks such as NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) and ISO/IEC 42001)
Deliver trusted analytics, business intelligence, KPI frameworks, dashboards, predictive models, and AI-enabled solutions — including Power BI visualization on the enterprise Lakehouse — that improve executive, operational, project, and functional decision-making, and leverage structured, unstructured, and IoT data to solve complex business challenges and improve project outcomes.
Lead enterprise automation services and the Automation Center of Excellence, including workflow automation, RPA, AI Agents, reusable patterns and templates, citizen-development guardrails, and consistent benefits realization through KPIs, ROI tracking, and process rationalization.
Champion enterprise data literacy, AI fluency, self-service analytics, adoption, and change management — including Bird's Data & AI Community of Practice and the Data & AI Fluency Journey — measuring and communicating the business value delivered through data, AI, and automation initiatives.
Build, coach, and lead a high-performing Data, AI & Automation Services team across Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, AI Specialists, and Automation professionals, and foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer service excellence in partnership with executive leadership, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Privacy, and business stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

Education

Post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
Master's degree considered an asset.

Experience

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, or Digital Transformation. Prior Director-level (or equivalent senior enterprise leadership) experience is required.
Demonstrated experience operating at the enterprise leadership level, including partnering directly with executive leadership and cross-functional , influencing strategic decisions, and communicating complex technical concepts in clear business language
Minimum 8 years of leadership experience managing high-performing technical teams.
Proven experience developing and executing enterprise data and AI strategies.
Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change, technology adoption, and enterprise capability-building initiatives , including data literacy, AI fluency, self-service analytics, and responsible AI adoption, across business functions

Technical Knowledge

Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, predictive analytics, and business intelligence.
Deep knowledge of data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, data governance, and enterprise analytics.
Experience with data quality management, master data management, metadata management, and information governance.
Knowledge of AI lifecycle management, responsible AI practices, and modern data engineering methodologies.
Experience building scalable data platforms and self-service analytics capabilities.

Data Governance and Data Fluency Competencies

Proven ability to embed governance and data fluency practices into analytics delivery, automation initiatives, AI adoption, and business transformation programs.
Experience translating complex data concepts into clear business language for executives, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to promote data fluency across business functions by improving data literacy, self-service analytics adoption, and responsible use of AI-enabled insights.
Strong understanding of data quality, metadata management, master data management, privacy, security, and information lifecycle management.
Demonstrated ability to establish data governance frameworks, stewardship models, data ownership practices, and enterprise data standards.

Leadership Skills

Strategic thinking and business acumen.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Proven ability to lead organizational change and technology adoption.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading enterprise AI adoption initiatives.
Experience implementing AI governance and data governance frameworks.
Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based industries is considered an asset.
Knowledge of project delivery methodologies including Agile and Scrum.

Success Measures

Adoption and business value realization of AI-enabled solutions.
Growth in enterprise data literacy and analytics adoption.
Improvements in data quality and governance maturity.
Productivity gains through automation and AI.
Delivery of strategic data platform and analytics initiatives.
Enhanced decision-making through trusted, accessible, and actionable data.
Development of a high-performing Data & Automation Services organization.

Applications

Applications are accepted online at www.bird.ca.

Please describe your experience with Business Intelligence, Machine Learning, Agile methodology, Data Warehouses, Generative AI, Data Governance, Data Fluency, and modern cloud data platforms in your cover letter and/or resume.

For Those Who Seek To Redefine

The greatest achievements in history are borne from the greatness within people – where human potential meets vision, and passion fuels evolution. Unlocking this potential is the most important thing we do at Bird.

As a leader in Canadian construction for over 100 years, the impact of our team is etched deeply within the core of our legacy. We Are Driven To Do Great Work

We built our name on quality. We have a passion for excellence in our work and relationships that honours our businesses and our industry.

Rooted in a solid foundation, we adapt and grow to face the future. We are committed to elevating each other to chart the best path forward in an evolving world.

At Bird, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) and believe it is essential to our success. We will continue to listen, learn, and take action in our commitment to building progress in our organization, and the industry as a whole. Cultivating an environment where all employees feel included, seen, and have a sense of belonging is core to Bird’s culture. The Technical Director defines and drives the technical strategy across the DataEdge portfolio. In close partnership with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and executive leadership, this role aligns product roadmaps, platform investments, and architectural decisions with customer needs, business objectives, and Rocket’s strategy to become a platform company.

The DataEdge portfolio includes Rocket’s data integration, replication, synchronization, virtualization, and data intelligence solutions. It helps customers unlock enterprise data across distributed, cloud, and mainframe environments by making trusted data available where it is needed. As AI adoption accelerates, DataEdge delivers trusted, connected, and actionable information to the applications, platforms, models, agents, and intelligent business processes that power modern digital enterprises.

This role will evolve the portfolio into an integrated platform through cloud-native architecture, shared services, AI-enabled innovation, and cross-product collaboration. The Technical Director will also work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, identify shared opportunities, and align architecture and investment decisions across portfolios. Success requires technical leadership and the ability to build alignment and shared ownership.

Partner with Product Management to define the DataEdge platform strategy and translate business priorities into a shared, cross-product technical roadmap.
Build alignment across Product, Engineering, and Architecture, balancing product needs with DataEdge platform objectives and the shared technical direction of the Data Modernization business unit.
Work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, align investments, and identify shared platform opportunities.

Define cloud-native strategies for deployment, configuration, scalability, observability, security, and operational excellence.

Shape DataEdge’s role in the broader data, analytics, and AI ecosystem through technology partnerships, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.

Lead architecture reviews, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and mentor Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.

jobs.title: Director, Systems & Data Transformation
jobs.description:
HSB Canada, part of Munich Re, is Canada’s premier engineering-driven specialty insurer—bringing deep technical expertise to help clients stay ahead of complex, emerging, and technology-based risks. We blend specialty insurance with inspection, engineering, and technology-enhanced services to redefine what risk protection can be, with leading capabilities across areas such as cyber, equipment breakdown, renewable energy, and IoT technology services.

Backed by Munich Re, one of the world’s most experienced and financially stable insurance and reinsurance groups, HSB Canada combines global strength with deep knowledge of the Canadian market. Building on a long legacy of innovation and technical excellence, we continue to evolve our capabilities to address modern and emerging risks—from cyber and artificial intelligence to connected technologies.

Primary Objectives

The Director, Systems & Data Transformation is accountable for shaping and executing HSB Canada’s enterprise systems, data, and digital transformation agenda. Acting as a strategic partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team, the Director translates business priorities into an integrated multi-year roadmap, leads complex cross-functional programs, and delivers measurable improvements in growth, customer and broker experience, operational effectiveness, decision-making, and risk management.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership for the transformation and optimization of the Guidewire ecosystem and its surrounding applications, integrations, data platforms, and controls, ensuring reliable and scalable support for policy, billing, claims, underwriting, and insurance operations.

The Director also leads the delivery of major business-facing capabilities, including Quote, Bind and Issue (QBI), underwriting workflow, digital experiences, enterprise data products, analytics, and responsible AI solutions, in close partnership with business, technology, operations, risk, and global stakeholders.

Success requires an enterprise-minded leader who can connect strategy, architecture, data, delivery, change management, and operational execution; build high-performing multidisciplinary teams; and establish the governance, partnerships, and performance disciplines needed to sustain transformation outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Transformation Strategy & Portfolio Delivery
Define and maintain an integrated, multi-year systems, data, and digital transformation strategy aligned with enterprise priorities and target business outcomes
Own the transformation portfolio from business case and prioritization through delivery, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations
Establish portfolio governance, roadmaps, investment plans, budgets, resource capacity, milestones, benefits, and executive reporting
Manage cross-program dependencies, delivery risks, organizational constraints, and competing priorities; escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations
Define measurable outcomes and key performance indicators, using performance insights to continuously improve delivery and business value
Core Systems Transformation & Guidewire Leadership
Set the strategy and roadmap for the specialty insurance technology ecosystem, balancing modernization, resilience, scalability, security, cost, and speed to market
Provide accountable leadership for the Guidewire platform and surrounding applications, including architecture, configuration, integrations, data flows, environments, releases, and lifecycle management
Lead major core-platform initiatives, including ClaimCenter transformation, while maintaining service continuity, production stability, support readiness, and effective control design
Digital Insurance & QBI Transformation
Lead end-to-end delivery of Quote, Bind and Issue capabilities and underwriting workflow improvements in partnership with underwriting, product, operations, distribution, and technology teams
Establish a scalable, reusable QBI architecture that supports multiple specialty products, distribution channels, evolving underwriting models, and integration with core platforms
Champion underwriter-centered design, process simplification, automation, and adoption to improve experience, quality, and cycle time
Data Science & Responsible AI
Define and mature HSB Canada’s enterprise data and data science capabilities, including data strategy, governance, quality, architecture, platforms, and reusable data products
Partner with business leaders to identify and deliver AI use cases across underwriting, claims, operations, finance, and distribution
Ensure data and AI solutions are explainable, secure, measurable, and embedded into business processes and decisions
Operating Model & People Leadership
Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing multidisciplinary team spanning business systems analysis, product and application leadership, data engineering, analytics, and data science
Define clear mandates, decision rights, accountabilities, delivery standards, and career pathways; create a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning
Develop workforce and sourcing strategies that balance internal capability, global partnerships, and external expertise while managing capacity and succession risk
Advisory, Change Leadership & Influence
Serve as a trusted advisor translating complex system and data topics into clear choices, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions
Build alignment across Canadian and global stakeholders, facilitate executive governance, and communicate progress, risks, investment needs, and realized outcomes with clarity
Lead organizational change and adoption for new capabilities, and bring external perspective, emerging practices, and market insight to continuously evolve HSB Canada’s business and technology environment

Qualifications

University-level education in computer science, business administration, risk management, or equivalent professional experience
8–12 years demonstrated experience in business, technology, or product roles; insurance or broader financial services
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving: ability to frame ambiguity, develop options, assess trade-offs, and drive to clear decisions.
Strong analytical capability: extracting insights from data and market research and translate them into strategy and action.
Multi-workstream leadership: proven ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel while maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder alignment.
Executive communication: ability to produce crisp, compelling materials and present complex topics simply and persuasively to senior audiences.
Strong P&C insurance (or broader financial services) product knowledge—coverage/wordings, underwriting appetite, pricing fundamentals, and regulatory considerations is an asset
Experience building ecosystems/partnerships (vendors, data providers, technology partners) to enable product and service innovation is an asset

Company Benefits:

Together, we engage with everything we have and are, to help humankind act braver and better. Go further with HSB.

We are pleased to offer our employees great benefits and resources to support their mental, physical and financial wellbeing. These include:

An engaging and collaborative environment that promotes continuous learning and development

jobs.description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program

About The Role

We are seeking a results-oriented Section Chief, Engineering to lead a team of project managers responsible for Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and engineering tools and ways-of-working improvement initiatives.

This role combines people leadership, portfolio management, and cross-functional coordination. The Section Chief develops team members, sets priorities, allocates resources, and ensures commitments are met for scope, schedule, cost, quality, and adoption. The leader works closely with Engineering, IT, Programs, and business partners to enable digital continuity, process integration, and the sustainable evolution of the engineering work environment.

What are your contributions to the team?

Lead, engage, and develop a team of project managers responsible for CAD, PLM, and engineering tools improvement initiatives.
Set objectives, clarify accountabilities, provide regular coaching, and manage performance and talent development effectively.
Manage and prioritize the project portfolio based on PDA needs, program objectives, business value, dependencies, available capacity, and risk.
Maintain rigorous project governance across scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, decisions, and performance indicators.
Ensure milestones and expected outcomes are achieved; act promptly to remove obstacles, arbitrate priorities, and implement recovery plans when required.
Align CAD, PLM, and engineering tools roadmaps with Engineering, IT, and Program priorities as well as enterprise architecture and standards.
Act as the primary liaison with leadership, functional owners, program teams, and IT partners to communicate portfolio status and facilitate decisions.
Oversee requirements definition, solution design, testing, deployment, and transition to operations to deliver robust, integrated, and sustainable solutions.
Champion structured change management, including communications, training, user readiness, adoption, and benefits tracking.
Support digital continuity and the integration of engineering data and processes across CAD, PLM, and related systems.
Ensure compliance with applicable security, quality, configuration management, and aerospace product development requirements.
Drive continuous improvement, standardize project management practices, and promote lessons learned across the team and its partners.

Key Competencies:

Engaging leadership, coaching, and talent development
Portfolio management, prioritization, and resource allocation
Results orientation, accountability, and business acumen
Strategic and systems thinking
Proactive management of risks, issues, and dependencies
Influence, communication, and stakeholder management
Complex problem-solving and decision-making
Change leadership and continuous improvement

How to thrive in this role?

You hold a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems Management, or a related field.
You have at least ten years of relevant experience in aerospace product development, digital transformation, or engineering tools deployment.
You have demonstrated experience in people management, coaching, or leading teams of professionals and project managers.
You have led a portfolio or multiple complex projects involving cross-functional dependencies, suppliers, and stakeholders at various levels.
You understand Product Development Aircraft (PDA) processes, engineering data, configuration management, and CAD and PLM environments.
You are proficient in planning, governance, risk management, financial tracking, and project performance measurement practices.
You demonstrate sound judgment, strong influencing skills, and excellent communication abilities in both French and English.
You can operate effectively in a matrix environment, manage competing priorities, and mobilize teams through change.

Preferred Qualifications:

Certification in project or portfolio management (PMP, PgMP, or equivalent), Agile methodology, or systems engineering (INCOSE).
Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, CAD solutions, or comparable platforms.
Knowledge of MBSE, digital twins, the digital thread, and model-based product development.
Experience in organizational change management, digital solution adoption, or process improvement.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, export control, and compliance requirements applicable to the aerospace industry.

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader fonctionnel d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur ou directrice), vous serez responsable des initiatives de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance, et guiderez les clients pendant la stratégie, la mise en œuvre et l’adoption.

À Ce Titre, Vous Devrez

Superviser la prestation de bout en bout des missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), le suivi financier, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Animer des ateliers d’établissement des exigences et de conception des processus, traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions fonctionnelles, en approche de configuration et en plans de mise en œuvre.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture et fournir des directives à cet égard, en assurant l’harmonisation avec l’architecture d’entreprise, l’évolutivité et la maintenabilité à long terme.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris Hyperion Planning et la gamme complète de modules EPBCS, en assurant l’alignement sur les objectifs du client et les pratiques exemplaires.
Guider les équipes tout au long de la conception du modèle de planification (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux de travail, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les décisions de conception sont adaptables et justifiables.
Aider les clients à définir des processus de planification et des modèles opérationnels futurs, en tirant parti des capacités Oracle EPM pour améliorer l’efficacité et les renseignements.
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du client au sein des équipes des finances, des TI et de la haute direction pour favoriser la prise de décisions, résoudre les problèmes et maintenir l’alignement dans l’ensemble du programme.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions répondent aux exigences et sont adoptées avec succès.
Diriger et encadrer les membres de l’équipe de prestation de services (conseillers et conseillers principaux) afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer aux efforts de développement des affaires par l’entremise d’offres de service, d’estimations, d’un soutien en matière de solutions et de présentations aux clients.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights, afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et les perspectives d’affaires.
Soutenir l’adoption de résultats propulsés par l’IA, comme des perspectives fondées sur l’IA et l’automatisation narrative, lorsque cela est possible dans l’écosystème Oracle EPM.

Le candidat retenu aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Sales Operations at Phreesia

Title:
Director, Head of Sales Operations

Team:
Phreesia Network Solutions

Location:
Remote EST or CST in Canada or the U.S., with occasional travel required for client meetings, industry events, conferences, and team collaboration.

Why This Role Exists

Phreesia Network Solutions partners with pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotech companies, media agencies, and other life sciences organizations to activate patients and engage providers with personalized, privacy-safe communications at the moments that matter most in care. Our media programs are sold — and re-sold — every year, which means our commercial engine has to run with precision: accurate forecasts, clean pipeline data, well-designed territories and quotas, and sellers who spend their time selling.

As Director, Head of Sales Operations, you will own that engine — and modernize it. You will be the connective tissue between Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Client Experience, and Client Solutions — turning strategy into operating cadence, data into decisions, and friction into process.

You will scale the commercial operation with AI at its backbone, embedding AI-driven forecasting, insights, and automation across the sales workflow so the team can grow revenue faster than headcount. Reporting to the SVP, Finance & Commercial Operations, you will lead an established Sales Operations team and own the systems, analytics, and planning disciplines that allow the PNS sales organization to scale efficiently as we grow across PatientConnect, ProviderConnect, MediFind, and our expanding solution portfolio.

What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing

Lead sales planning and go-to-market design. You’ll lead annual and quarterly sales planning across territory, capacity, quota, and compensation planning — designing balanced territories and account segmentation, modeling headcount needs, setting quotas tied to forecast targets, and partnering with Finance and People teams on compensation plans that incentivize the right behaviors across new business, renewals, and upsell. You’ll also support go-to-market planning for new offerings, ensuring rules of engagement, coverage, and targets are in place at launch.
Own forecasting and pipeline management. You’ll own the forecasting process and cadence, delivering accurate, defensible revenue forecasts across new business, renewals, and expansion for a business built on annually re-sold media programs. You’ll establish pipeline hygiene standards, stage definitions, and inspection rhythms; run weekly pipeline and forecast reviews with Sales leadership; and partner with Finance on bookings-to-revenue reconciliation, campaign delivery pacing, and quarterly business reviews.
Turn commercial data into actionable insights. You’ll build and maintain the reporting suite for the business, including pipeline, win/loss, retention and renewal rates, upsell, rep productivity, and brand- and agency-level performance. You’ll deliver insights that shape strategy — identifying where we’re winning, where deals stall, and which therapeutic areas and agency relationships are growing — and present those insights to senior leadership. You’ll also define and govern a single source of truth for commercial data across systems.
Scale systems, tools, and AI capabilities. You’ll own the sales technology stack — with Salesforce as the backbone, alongside forecasting, enablement, data enrichment, and workflow tools — including administration, roadmap, integrations, and vendor management. You’ll define and execute an AI roadmap for the commercial organization, deploying AI agents, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation to improve forecast accuracy, surface deal risk and next-best actions, automate non-selling work, and increase seller productivity. You’ll drive CRM adoption and data quality, design workflows that reduce manual effort for sellers and account teams, and ensure the clean, governed data foundation that AI-driven insights depend on. You’ll also evaluate emerging AI tooling with a practical eye — piloting quickly, measuring impact, and scaling what works.
Improve deal support and commercial processes. You’ll run deal desk functions, including pricing governance, approval workflows, proposal support, and order processing in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Client Experience. You’ll continuously identify and remove friction across the quote-to-cash process and own rules of engagement across Sales, Client Experience, and Market Development.
Scale sales best practices. You’ll identify what’s working across outreach cadences, deal motions, and renewal plays and scale those practices across the team to shorten sales cycles and maximize selling time. You’ll partner closely with Sales Enablement and Training, which is owned separately, to ensure process changes, tooling, and best practices are embedded in onboarding and ongoing coaching.
Lead and develop the Sales Operations team. You’ll lead, develop, and mentor an established Sales Operations team spanning analytics, systems administration, and deal support, shaping the function’s structure as the business grows. You’ll serve as a trusted operating partner to the SVP, Finance & Commercial Operations, Client Experience, and Sales leadership, taking meaningful non-selling work off the plates of the sales team so they can focus on clients and revenue.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You will be a great fit if you are:

Bring deep, hands-on expertise with Salesforce, including administration, reporting, and process design, and ideally have experience owning a broader revenue technology stack
Have demonstrated ownership of forecasting, territory and quota planning, and sales compensation design within a quota-carrying sales organization
Bring experience in media, advertising, point-of-care marketing, life sciences, or healthcare technology; familiarity with annually renewing or re-sold revenue models is a plus
Have a strong analytical toolkit, including hands-on use of AI tools for analysis, forecasting, and workflow automation, such as Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, generative AI assistants, or similar
Are highly proficient with Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL and Power BI or similar BI tools is preferred
Know how to turn complex data into a clear, compelling narrative for executives
Have a demonstrated track record of scaling a commercial function with AI and automation — identifying use cases, driving adoption, and measuring productivity impact
Bring excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills and are comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on levels in a fast-growing business

We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check

Bachelor’s degree required
10+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or commercial strategy, including 3+ years leading the function or a significant portion of it
Prior people management experience

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote role, with the expectation that you’re based in EST or CST in Canada or the U.S. Occasional travel is required for client meetings, industry events, conferences, and team collaboration.

Compensation & Rewards

Base Salary: $240,000-260,000 USD or $200,000-230,000 CAD (depending on experience) inclusive of base salary and variable incentive.
A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work

Who We Are

At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care.

Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit!

Top-rated Employee Benefits

100% Remote work + home office expense reimbursements
Competitive compensation

Continuing education and professional certification reimbursement

Who We Are

Founded in 1993, Kinross is a Canadian-based senior gold mining company with operations and projects in the United States, Brazil, Mauritania, Chile and Canada. Our focus on delivering value is based on our four core values of Putting People First, Outstanding Corporate Citizenship, High Performance Culture, and Rigorous Financial Discipline.

In line with our values, we also aim to build meaningful partnerships with all of our stakeholders, including communities, shareholders, employees, governments and suppliers.

Kinross maintains listings on the Toronto Stock Exchange (symbol: K) and the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: KGC).

The Director, Geological Data & Database Management is a senior technical leadership role accountable for designing, implementing, and governing a company-wide database management system across all exploration, project, and operating sites. Ensure standardization of the company geologic database platform across all exploration, project, and operating sites, including migration of legacy and existing site databases where required.
Maintain database standards for structure, content, and required tables at each project maturity point (Setup, Initial Drilling, Infill, Scoping, PFS, FS, and Operations), and ensure sites are equipped to meet them.
Lead selection, configuration, and lifecycle management of database software and related tools, in partnership with IT.
Ensure QA/QC protocols are implemented and auditable per internal standards.
Establish and audit data security controls across all sites: layered/restricted access by user type, edit tracking and audit trails, and automatic, regular backups including offsite storage.
Define and enforce the separation between dynamic project databases and frozen, dated resource-model databases used for reserve/resource work.
Lead systematic, scheduled reviews of database quality across all sites and drive corrective action plans ahead of each project maturity point.
Initiate and lead internal and external audits as required.
Build, lead, and develop the company database management function, including hiring and mentoring site and project database administrators and analysts.
liase with exploration management, KTS, and site geology teams to ensure database structures support geological, resource, and reserve modelling requirements.
Develop and deliver training and documented procedures for database administrators, geologists, and technical staff on data entry standards, QA/QC execution, and system use.
Maintain and continuously improve governing documentation (standards guides, database structure references.)
Report on database health, compliance, and risk to senior technical and executive leadership.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, Geological Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in mineral exploration or mining geology, including significant experience in geological database design, administration, or data management.
5+ years in a senior or leadership role managing database systems, technical teams, or data governance programs across multiple sites or projects.
Demonstrated experience implementing or administering industry-standard geological database platforms (e.g., acQuire, Fusion, Datashed, or comparable systems) at a multi-site scale.

Technical & Leadership Skills

Deep understanding of relational database structures as applied to drill hole data (collar, survey, lithology, assay, QA/QC, geotechnical, geometallurgical, density, and related tables).
Strong knowledge of QA/QC protocols, chain-of-custody procedures, and data security/access-control best practices in a geological or mining context.
Proven ability to lead large-scale systems and change management initiatives across geographically distributed sites.
Excellent people-leadership skills, with experience building and managing teams, including remote or site-based staff and dotted-line reporting relationships.
Strong communication skills, able to translate technical database requirements for both site-level technical staff and executive leadership.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly to exploration, project, and operating sites, including remote locations.

The hiring range reflects our targeted compensation framework for the role. The actual offer will be determined through a comprehensive evaluation of each candidate’s experience, capabilities, and potential impact, along with consideration of internal equity, team structure, and benchmark market data for similar positions. Have many careers in one Firm.

Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

What will your typical day look like?

As a Director within Deloitte’s Deal Transformation & Post Merger Integration (DT&PMI) Human Resources Due Diligence (HRDD) practice, you will play a leadership role in advising private equity investors and corporate clients on the financial, operational and strategic implications of human capital matters across complex M&A transactions.

Combining strong commercial judgment, quantitative analytical capabilities and human capital expertise, you will lead financially focused due diligence engagements to identify and quantify material transaction risks, assess historical and prospective workforce costs, and uncover opportunities for EBITDA improvement and enterprise value creation.

Your work will span complex compensation and benefits arrangements, pensions and other employee liabilities, workforce cost structures, organizational effectiveness and carve-out considerations. You will translate these findings into actionable insights that inform transaction economics, deal structuring, negotiations and post-acquisition priorities.

Beyond leading engagements, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, collaborate with multidisciplinary deal teams, mentor and develop high-performing professionals, and contribute to the continued growth of the practice.

Responsibilities

Lead Transaction Due Diligence: Direct financially focused human capital due diligence engagements, identifying and quantifying material risks, liabilities, cost exposures and opportunities that could influence transaction value, deal terms and post-closing priorities.
Assess Financial and Commercial Deal Implications: Analyze historical and projected workforce costs, including compensation, benefits, pensions, executive arrangements and transaction-related obligations, to evaluate implications for normalized EBITDA, net debt, cash flow and transaction economics.
Drive Value Creation: Identify and assess opportunities for labor cost optimization, workforce productivity, organizational effectiveness, spans and layers improvements, and sustainable EBITDA enhancement.
Lead Workforce Analytics and Financial Modeling: Direct complex quantitative analyses using workforce, payroll and financial datasets, developing robust models and defensible financial estimates despite incomplete or imperfect information.
Advise on Carve-outs and Standalone Requirements: Assess standalone operating models, workforce structures, stranded costs, incremental costs, employee transition requirements and Transition Service Agreements (TSAs).
Deliver Executive-Level Insights: Synthesize complex technical findings into clear, commercially relevant recommendations for private equity investors, corporate executives, investment teams and other transaction stakeholders.
Collaborate Across Deal Disciplines: Work closely with Financial Due Diligence, M&A, tax, legal, operational and technology advisory teams to connect human capital findings to the broader transaction thesis and diligence conclusions.
Lead Client Engagements and Develop Talent: Independently manage complex engagements, facilitate discussions with senior management, oversee delivery quality, and mentor, coach and develop high-performing teams.
Contribute to Practice Growth: Develop trusted client relationships, support business development, identify cross-functional opportunities and help expand Deloitte’s human capital transaction advisory capabilities.

About The Team

Our Human Resources Due Diligence practice is part of Deloitte’s Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) business, within the Deal Transformation & Post Merger Integration (DT&PMI) team.

We operate at the intersection of M&A, finance and human capital, helping private equity investors and corporate clients understand how workforce-related risks, liabilities, costs and opportunities influence deal value.

Our engagements combine transaction advisory, quantitative analysis and specialized human capital expertise, often in close collaboration with Financial Due Diligence and other M&A advisory teams.

Joining our growing practice offers the opportunity to advise on complex, high-profile transactions, work across diverse industries and jurisdictions, mentor and develop talented professionals, and contribute to building a differentiated advisory offering within Deloitte’s M&A business.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

Transaction Advisory and Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of M&A transactions, investment considerations and financial drivers of deal value, with the ability to connect human capital findings to transaction economics and business decisions.
Quantitative and Financial Analytical Capabilities: Ability to interpret complex financial and workforce information, assess cost structures, build or review financial models, and evaluate implications for EBITDA, net debt, cash flow and enterprise value.
Human Capital Expertise: Strong knowledge of workforce costs, compensation, employee benefits, pensions, executive arrangements, organizational structures or other material human capital considerations. Depth in one or more specialized areas and an ability to evaluate broader implications are valued.
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical judgment, intellectual curiosity and ability to structure ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and derive evidence-based conclusions from incomplete information.
Strategic and Value Creation Orientation: Ability to identify opportunities for organizational effectiveness, operating cost improvement and sustainable value creation, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Executive Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex financial and technical matters into concise, persuasive insights for senior executives, private equity investors and deal stakeholders.
Technical Proficiency: Advanced Excel modeling and PowerPoint skills. Experience with large datasets, payroll or workforce information, or tools such as Power BI, Tableau or SQL is an asset.
Leadership and Talent Development: Ability to lead complex engagements and multidisciplinary teams, mentor professionals, provide constructive feedback, and foster a high-performing team environment.
Client Management: Ability to build trusted relationships with senior clients, manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under demanding transaction timelines.
Commercial and Growth Mindset: Ability to identify client needs, contribute to business development and help grow a specialized advisory practice.

Minimum Experience

Typically 10+ years of progressive experience in transaction advisory, M&A consulting, human capital advisory, actuarial or rewards consulting, restructuring, operational improvement, or related financial and strategic advisory disciplines, including significant leadership responsibilities.
Experience evaluating complex business issues through quantitative and financial analysis, translating findings into strategic recommendations and measurable commercial outcomes.
Meaningful exposure to M&A transactions, financial due diligence, carve-outs, integrations, business transformation or value creation initiatives. Experience leading human capital due diligence engagements is a strong asset.
Understanding of workforce-related financial and operational considerations, supported by experience in compensation, benefits, pensions, workforce analytics, organizational effectiveness or labor cost optimization.
Proven success leading multidisciplinary engagements, advising senior stakeholders, mentoring professionals and building trusted client relationships.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, mathematics, actuarial science, statistics, business, engineering or a related quantitative or analytical discipline.
CFA, CPA, CBV or actuarial designations (e.g., ASA, ACIA, FSA, FCIA), or equivalent qualifications, are assets.

Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

At BMO Commercial Bank, we're looking for an accomplished commercial banking leader to drive growth, inspire high-performing teams, and deepen relationships with some of the region's most influential businesses.

You'll partner with senior executives, business owners, and key decision-makers while collaborating across BMO's extensive network of specialists to bring the full strength of the bank to every client relationship.

Drive business development strategies that expand BMO's presence and market share.

Manage and grow a portfolio of complex, high-value client relationships.
Resolve sophisticated client challenges while ensuring an exceptional client experience.
